digest.en: Pakistan's northwest security crackdown dominates. Brazil's post-coup rainforest vision offers a stark contrast. Africa's online news creators are also reshaping the ecosphere.
digest.hi: मुंबई की प्लेऑफ की उम्मीदों पर फिरा पानी, आरसीबी बनी टेबल टॉपर। बीजेपी के उभार से क्षेत्रीय पार्टियों की पहचान की राजनीति पर असर पड़ रहा है। शनि जयंती पर तेल चढ़ाते समय गलतियों से बचना महत्वपूर्ण है।

articles.title: 15 security officials killed in militant attack in northwest Pakistan
articles.summary: Fifteen security officials died in a militant attack in northwest Pakistan The impact of the explosion led to the collapse of the roofs of several houses in the vicinity. The police post building was also razed to the ground, and several security personnel were buried under the rubble.

articles.title: Film paints vision of a post-coup Brazil giving up rainforest
articles.summary: A fictional film depicts Brazil in 2025 following a successful rightwing coup. The plot shows the assassination of the president and the closure of congress. The new government then cedes control of the Amazon rainforest to the United States. The film highlights threats to Indigenous peoples.

articles.title: Non-binary Indian migrant elected member of Scottish Parliament
articles.summary: Manivannan, a non-binary Indian migrant, was “As a queer Tamil immigrant, I am standing to be an MSP to bring a politics of care and compassion to Holyrood, to fight for the radical change our working-class and marginalised communities need," says Manivannan in his poll pitch for the Scottish Greens.

articles.summary: Argentina is under scrutiny for hantavirus after authorities began tracing passengers from a Thirty years after first person-to-person transmission was documented in Patagonia, scientists say global heating could increase world’s exposureAn outbreak in rural communities 30 years ago in the Patagonia area of Argentina led scientists, for the first time, to document person-to-person transmission of hantavirus, which until then had been known only to spread through contact with rodents. articles.title: ‘Watching us is like watching a cousin’: the online creators reshaping Africa’s news ecosphere
articles.summary: Amahle-Imvelo Jaxa posted a TikTok video explaining a dispute between the South African and Rwandan presidents. She detailed the roles of various South African groups in a conflict. Jaxa's content focuses on current affairs for a South African audience. Africa is leading a change in news consumption habits – and transforming the lives of current affairs enthusiastsLast year Amahle-Imvelo Jaxa posted a TikTok video about South African peacekeepers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

articles.title: Guardian reporter and colleagues detained and beaten by Somali police
articles.summary: Guardian reporter Mohamed Bulbul was detained and beaten by Somali police in Mogadishu. He was arrested with two colleagues, Abdihafid Nor Barre and Abdishakur Mohamed Moh. The arrests followed Bulbul's reporting for the Guardian on the alleged torture of a woman in prison.

articles.title: Revisiting Guy Goma's iconic accidental BBC interview 20 years ago this week
articles.summary: Guy Goma appeared live on BBC News 20 years ago this NPR's Elissa Nadworny talks to Guy Goma who thought he was being interviewed for an IT job at the BBC but instead found himself live on air. His interview 20 years ago became a viral sensation.

articles.title: Central African Republic: Funding cuts put humanitarian support at risk
articles.summary: Funding cuts threaten humanitarian operations in the Central African Republic. The Central African Republic (CAR) is making progress towards stability and security but major aid budget cuts threaten humanitarian operations there, a senior official with the UN aid coordination office OCHA said on Friday in New York.

articles.title: Three evacuated from hantavirus-hit ship as Spain says vessel can dock
articles.summary: Spain allowed the MV Hondius cruise ship to dock after three people British guide Martin Anstee among those evacuated from MV Hondius, which is now heading for Canary IslandsExplainer: What is hantavirus? Three people with suspected hantavirus have been medically evacuated from a cruise ship. They include a British man who was an expedition guide onboard the ship, the MV Hondius.

articles.summary: बीजेपी के उभार से क्षेत्रीय पार्टियों की पहचान की राजनीति कमज़ोर हो रही है. 2014 के बाद से क्षेत्रीय दलों का कमज़ोर होना जारी है. 90के दशक के बाद देश में भर में क्षेत्रीय पार्टियों का उभार हुआ. इनके बिना दिल्ली में सरकार नहीं बनती थी.
